$comment: Shared, committed Claude Code settings for Afloat - every clone gets the same
agent behaviour. Personal settings (your permission approvals, commit
attribution) belong in .claude/settings.local.json, which is gitignored;
make claude-install seeds it from
.claude/settings.local.json.example. Paths use ${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR} so this
file is portable across clones - never hardcode an absolute path here.
Note: allow-rules in a committed settings.json require the one-time
workspace-trust prompt before they take effect.
model + effortLevel pin the orchestrator's tier and effort (BOOTSTRAP.md
§13); 'opus' is an alias, so the model behind it floats. They are a default,
not enforcement: /effort, --effort and CLAUDE_CODE_EFFORT_LEVEL all win, and
the env var wins over everything. Role agents pin their own effort in
.claude/agents/*.md frontmatter, which overrides the session level.
CLAUDE_CODE_FORK_SUBAGENT=0 turns off the built-in 'fork' agent type. While
forks are on, every subagent runs in the background, so CLAUDE.md's
foreground rule could not be followed. Afloat delegates only to its role
agents, never to forks.
The Agent hook makes every subagent spawn a permission prompt.
gh issue: only view and list are allowed. Anyone can write an issue, and
agents read issue text as live state, so a write (create, comment, edit,
close, delete, transfer) always prompts - an instruction planted in an
issue must never publish without a human.
make: the gates and the generators only. db-reset, conformance and
test-migrations wipe or recreate data and always prompt.
